waves.name: Nightly batch cycle (MAINJOB)
waves.rationale: One JCL job runs one program (app/jcl/MAINJOB.jcl:2). The program touches no dataset, so the family is batch-readonly by fact. It is the whole reachable system, so it is the whole nightly cycle as far as this tree shows. The program calls a name it reads at run time (app/cbl/PGMMAIN.cbl:9), so the real scope of the wave is not known until that name is known.
waves.unblocks: Nothing in this tree. No other unit depends on it. It is the only wave, so it is the proof of the toolchain and the equivalence harness.

unassigned.reason: not reached by any static edge, and 1 reachable computed call(s) could target it, for example at app/cbl/PGMMAIN.cbl:9
